blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Two bills seeking to promote the recognition of Filipino women in history through school curricula and a proposed national museum have been filed before the Senate. Sen. Loren Legarda featured the two measures in a Facebook post on Tuesday, saying they aim to give greater recognition to Filipino women in schools and museums to ensure their stories and contributions are passed on to younger generations.
